```{r msi_external_prep}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

msi_ext <- pcgrr::msi_external_display(
  pcg_report$content$msi,
  classifier_ref = if (msi_tabs) paste0("the tab \"", msi_tab_clf, "\"") else "below")

cat("The MSI status below was determined by an external MSI caller (__",
    msi_ext$caller, "__), and provided as input to PCGR. ", sep = "")
if (msi_ext$zero_loci) {
  cat("\n\n::: {.callout-warning}\n**No microsatellite loci evaluated**\n\n",
      "The MSI caller reported no evaluated microsatellite loci - the MSI status cannot be determined.",
      "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
}

ext_status_theme <- "dark"
if (msi_ext$status == "Indeterminate") {
  ext_status_theme <-
    bslib::value_box_theme(bg = pcgrr::color_palette$warning, fg = "#000000")
}
```

```{r msi_external_boxes}
#| echo: false

bslib::layout_columns(
  col_widths = c(4, 4, 4),
  height = "110px",
  bslib::value_box(
    title = "MSI status",
    value = msi_ext$status,
    showcase = NULL,
    theme = ext_status_theme
  ),
  bslib::value_box(
    title = msi_ext$score_title,
    value = msi_ext$score_value,
    showcase = NULL,
    theme = "dark"
  ),
  bslib::value_box(
    title = if (is.na(msi_ext$loci_value)) "MSI caller" else "Unstable loci / evaluated loci",
    value = if (is.na(msi_ext$loci_value)) msi_ext$caller else msi_ext$loci_value,
    showcase = NULL,
    theme = "dark"
  )
)
```

```{r msi_external_notes}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

cat("\n\n", msi_ext$basis_note, "\n\n", sep = "")

if (!is.na(msi_ext$concordance)) {
  if (msi_ext$concordance == "concordant") {
    cat("::: {.callout-note}\n**Concordance with PCGR MSI classifier**\n\n",
        "The result is concordant with the prediction of the PCGR MSI classifier (",
        msi_ext$classifier_detail, "). See ", msi_ext$classifier_ref, " for details.",
        "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
  } else if (msi_ext$concordance == "discordant") {
    cat("::: {.callout-warning}\n**Discordance with PCGR MSI classifier**\n\n",
        msi_ext$discordance_note,
        "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
  } else if (msi_ext$concordance == "not_evaluable") {
    cat("::: {.callout-note}\n**PCGR MSI classifier**\n\n",
        "The MSI status from the external caller is indeterminate, and cannot be compared with the prediction of the PCGR MSI classifier (",
        msi_ext$classifier_detail, "). See ", msi_ext$classifier_ref, " for details. The classifier prediction is used for the assessment of MSI-High biomarker evidence.",
        "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
cat("<br>\n\n")
```
